name: Exp_BlauTSStochastic
summary: This EA trades based on the Blau Triple Smoothed Stochastic indicator, supporting three entry modes: zero-line breakout, histogram direction reversal, and signal cloud color change. It uses multi-layer smoothing (up to four averaging passes) to generate trading signals and applies configurable money management with stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Blau三重平滑随机指标进行交易，支持三种入场模式：零线突破、柱状图方向反转和信号云颜色变化。它使用多层平滑（最多四次平均）生成交易信号，并应用可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Blau三重平滑随机指标（BlauTSStochastic），该指标通过对价格进行多级平滑处理来消除噪声并提取动量信号。入场条件提供三种模式：breakdown模式为柱状图突破零线时入场，twist模式为柱状图方向改变时入场，cloudtwist模式为信号线上穿或下穿信号云时入场。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，同时支持反向信号平仓（如多头信号出现时平空头仓位）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数或按存款比例计算手数（由MMMode决定）。资金管理方面，MM参数为正值时按存款比例下单，为负值时直接作为手数使用，但缺乏最大仓位限制和回撤控制机制。该策略属于典型的动量跟踪系统，多层平滑旨在减少假信号，但也可能导致信号滞后。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the Blau Triple Smoothed Stochastic indicator, which applies multiple layers of smoothing to price data to filter noise and extract momentum signals. Entry conditions are provided in three modes: breakdown mode enters when the histogram crosses the zero line, twist mode enters when the histogram direction reverses, and cloudtwist mode enters when the signal line crosses above or below the signal cloud. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, with additional exits via opposing signals (e.g., closing shorts when a long signal appears). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lot size or deposit-proportional sizing as determined by the MMMode enumeration. Money management allows MM as a deposit share when positive or as a direct lot size when negative, but lacks maximum position limits or drawdown controls. The multi-layer smoothing (four sequential averaging passes) aims to reduce false signals but inherently introduces signal lag, making it more suitable for higher timeframes where trend persistence is stronger.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lots; negative = lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in pips (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：零线突破/方向反转/云色变化
parameters.description_en: Entry mode: zero-line breakout / direction change / cloud color change

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 提供三种灵活的入场模式，适应不同市场环境和个人偏好
多层平滑有效过滤市场噪声，减少虚假信号触发
支持按存款比例自动计算仓位，便于风险管理
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一根K线重复开仓，降低过度交易风险
止损止盈参数可配置，提供基本的风险保护
pros_en: Three flexible entry modes adapt to different market conditions and trader preferences
Multi-layer smoothing effectively filters market noise and reduces false signal triggers
Deposit-proportional position sizing supports automated risk management
IsNewBar mechanism prevents duplicate entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Configurable stop loss and take profit provide basic risk protection
cons: 多层平滑导致信号严重滞后，可能错过最佳入场时机
缺乏点差过滤和滑点保护，在高点差环境下可能亏损
没有最大回撤控制或仓位上限，极端行情下风险敞口过大
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点设置过于宽泛，不适合所有品种
依赖自定义指标文件，若指标缺失则EA无法运行
cons_en: Multi-layer smoothing causes significant signal lag, potentially missing optimal entry points
Lacks spread filter and slippage protection, which may cause losses in high-spread environments
No maximum drawdown control or position limit, exposing excessive risk in extreme market conditions
Default SL of 1000 points and TP of 2000 points are overly wide and unsuitable for all instruments
Depends on a custom indicator file; EA fails to run if the indicator is missing
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时间限制，避免高点差时段和低流动性时段开仓
添加最大回撤保护和动态仓位调整机制，根据账户权益变化自动缩减仓位
引入追踪止损或移动止盈功能，在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
增加指标数据有效性检查和重试机制，提高异常情况下的鲁棒性
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid entries during high-spread and low-liquidity periods
Implement maximum drawdown protection and dynamic position adjustment that reduces exposure based on account equity changes
Introduce trailing stop or dynamic take-profit to lock in more profits during extended trends
Add indicator data validity checks and retry mechanisms to improve robustness under exceptional conditions

risk_points: 多层平滑信号滞后可能导致趋势末端入场，止损被触发概率增加
缺乏回撤控制和仓位上限，连续亏损时风险敞口不可控
依赖外部自定义指标，指标加载失败时EA无法交易但未提供降级方案
risk_points_en: Signal lag from multi-layer smoothing may cause entries at trend exhaustion, increasing stop loss hit probability
Lack of drawdown control and position limits means uncontrolled risk exposure during consecutive losses
Dependency on external custom indicator provides no fallback when indicator loading fails
